This hybrid meeting is taking place via Microsoft Teams & at the Girdwood Community Room, 250 Egloff Rd:

The Girdwood Board of Supervisors is subject to the Alaska Open Meetings Act as found in Alaska Statute 44.62.310
and Anchorage Municipal Code1.25 - Public Meetings.
The Girdwood Board of Supervisors operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Call to Order 7:00 p.m. Mike Edgington, Co-Chair

Land Acknowledgement: The Girdwood Board of Supervisors acknowledges the indigenous peoples of Alaska, whose land we
reside on. The community of Girdwood, situated between the areas known to be Dena'ina and Alutiiq homeland, respects the people
who were stewards of this land for generations. We commit to the continued stewardship of this land and are grateful to be part of a
wider community that seeks to maintain a sustainable use of Girdwood Valley for present and future peoples.

6.  Agenda Item LUC 2512-06: Federation of Community Councils
              a.  Update on FCC Bylaws: Bylaws are being updated by FCC and may be voted on at their March Meeting. LUC has
                 not made a recommendation for GBOS regarding the bylaws.
              b.  Discuss FCC delegate: GBOS has previously assigned Land Use Chair to FCC

Mike Edginginton recuses himself from FCC Bylaws discussion based on personal interest.
He is removed from the FCC delegate discussion through decision of the chair, Kellie Okonek, based on the same finding by chair at
the Jan GBOS meeting. Edgington challenges this decision by the chair but there is no second.

Several motions were made to reconsider the vote from January and return to the decision from the November GBOS Meeting,
however these did not make it to a vote. Chair determines that GBOS has done what they can with the topic as it stands and that there
is no additional action to be taken, considering the topic closed.

Any future action on FCC must come back through new business from Land Use.

Mike Edgington returns to chair

8.  Agenda Item LUC 2510-07: LUC recommendation for GBOS letters regarding Solid Waste Services Fee increase (to be
    discussed at MOA GBOS Quarterly Meeting 1/26/26) (Wilbanks/Wingard).
Concern is for the outsized impact of increase in SWS fees in Girdwood and the need to dispose of smaller loads of trash often instead
of storing up. This keeps trash away from residences and improves compliance with requirements for Secure Trash Regulation Zone.
It is understood that the fees are collected by SWS but are used by Parks and Rec for trash removal in parks and public spaces. It is
understood that adding Sunday service, which was also requested for consideration, is unlikely because transfer station employees are
union represented and this is likely outside of their contract. Addition of recycling is a separate, but related topic, which is handled under
new business later in the agenda. Local recycling would cut down on the amount of trash going to the transfer station.

Change to the fee structure, which is in place currently, would likely require a code change.

9.  Agenda Item LUC 2601-04: LUC recommendation for GBOS action regarding Virgin Creek Avalanche Mitigation/Control
    Development Project Conditional Use Permit approval. (Tim Glassett, DOT&PF)
   PCZ Case 2026-0042, Amendment to T21C9 to align with the Girdwood Comprehensive Plan related to the rezone of the old
    gravel pit to Airport for heli-pad/avalanche mitigation in the Seward Highway Corridor. Scheduled for hearing MON March 9 at
    PZC. (Paul Hatcher, Current Planning, presenting)
    Resolution of Support for zoning change, Conditional Use Permit
    https://www.muni.org/CityViewPortal/Planning/Status?planningId=18375.

There are two Planning and Zoning actions and later a Conditional Use Permit will be required.
Edgington provided a draft resolution of support.

Motion:
GBOS moves to approve Resolution 2026-01: Resolution of Support for re-zone of the Old Gravel Pit parcel to support remote
avalanche control systems along the Seward Highway corridor and to update Land Use Code for the Girdwood Airport zone to follow
the intent of the 2025 Girdwood Comprehensive Plan.
Motion by KO/JW
Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote.

10. GHEC current and upcoming vacancy

smaller number.

11. Safer Seward Highway proposal Home_DraftEA - Safer Seward Highway Safer Seward Highway
   Comment period extended to 2.27.26
There is considerable interest and discussion regarding the Environmental Assessment. Ky Holland has provided a draft letter that
others may use to frame their input to DOT. GBOS considers writing a letter and is concerned about highway safety as well as
maintaining the viewshed and character of the Seward Highway. However, there is no member or team of members available to write a
letter on behalf of GBOS prior to Feb 27 deadline.
